rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight powers
fused form of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ; equates attainment of the eight powers with the root Kaula

items.question: What is identified as the root Kaula in relation to the attainment of the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are named as attained accomplishments.
The attainment of these powers is equated with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific list of the eight powers is not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
